snippet.title: Blue Ridge Hunting - Official Chapter 1 Release Window Trailer | Women-Led Games x SGF 2026
snippet.description: Take a look at the Chapter 1 Release Window Trailer for Blue Ridge Hunting, a first-person co-op horror game developed by Jade Meadows. Players will investigate, document, and hunt cryptids based on real sightings in the Appalachian Mountains. Chapter 1 of Blue Ridge Hunting is launching in August 2026 for PC (Steam), with a Kickstarter available now to support the development of the game.
